newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rally to close up on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rally to close up on U.S. data.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Friday after rallying out of the doldrums on U.S. February PPI data, with dealers seeing more gains on Monday.

"The market has been volatile today. It looked like we were heading for a moderate decline but then things bucked up on the U.S. data and purchase orders for KFX paper with the index closing higher. We could well continue up," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index finished 1.39 point up at 159.92 in overall bourse turnover of 1.413 billion crowns. The KFX March future rose 1.30 point to 157.70 with 237 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Virtually all KFX shares had a good day, with A.P. Moeller and Berendsen doing particularly well.
Moeller's D/S 1912 and D/S Svendborg put on 2,000 and 5,000 crowns respectively to close at 200,000 and 285,000 while Berendsen put on six to end the week at 811.
East Asiatic recovered on top of a poor reaction to its 1996 result, finishing six crowns up at 158.

With the Phoenix takeover bid saga probably nearing its end after its board recommended Norway's Rieber offer, the Phoenix share ended 1.36 crown lower at 709.64.--Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969650
